content_of_post_to_comment: I'm obsessed with true intellectualism now that pseudo-intellectualism has become so common. Seriously grappling with the strongest opposition to your claim? Taking devil's advocate to see a position from different perspectives? Using evidence to make your argument? Like witnessing magic.
comment: The tricky part is that intellectual humility can become another identity performance. The real test may be whether we're willing to update our beliefs when the evidence stops favoring us, not just whether we can argue both sides.
